title: Explosive Tag Kunai
body:
Syntax: explosive tag kunai <target>

Description: A Bukijutsu jutsu, unlocked at level 30. Used by typing its name directly. 62-71 physical damage, costs 15 Chakra and 10 Stamina, 6 second cooldown.

Same kunai-consuming, ground-dropping mechanics as Throw Kunai -- but there's a 30% chance the kunai is rigged to detonate instead, dealing a much bigger 172-189 explosive hit rather than the normal damage. It's always one or the other on a given throw, never both.

Date: 2026-08-23
